newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt market ends softer following offshore.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt market ends softer following offshore.

text.p: 1530 GMT - Sweden's debt market weakened in afternoon trade on Monday in line with offshore markets after yields fell in early trade.
But dealers said trade was light with little direction to the market. They said the focus throughout the week would be on key economic figures being released in the U.S..
* Six-month T-bill rate steady at 4.52 pct
* Nine-year bond yield rises one to 7.19 pct
* Crowns firms vs mark to 4.3260 against 4.3295 Friday

The Swedish debt market opened firmer in bullish mood following optimistic late trade on Friday. However, weaker foreign markets dominated for the rest of the day and the bond yields closed a touch higher.
The market was mostly sidelined ahead of the U.S. data due later this week, dealers said.
Nine-year bond yields rose one basis point to 7.19 percent. The spread between Swedish and German long yields was unchanged at 117 basis points.
